decisions.reason: The broader Hero V exploration does not change the requirement that the É accent ultimately derive from the resolved Hero V geometry.
The source changes how the Hero V will be explored but does not change the closing V's derivation from the eventual Hero V geometry or its required shared characteristics.
The source concerns exploration of the Hero V as a whole and does not alter the deferred architectural E and L letterform requirements.
The Hero V geometry exploration strategy does not change the deferred champagne material treatment or its role in enhancing the resolved design.
The source does not address kerning or change the deferred requirement for the full wordmark to read as a unified mark.
Exploring broader Hero V concepts does not change the established visual hierarchy in which the closing V remains smaller and subordinate.
The design-direction modification is unrelated to the task-local requirement for Mac-viewable proof formats.
